notes: Model code LH55QMCEBGCXXY (region suffix varies, e.g. -XXY/-XGO/-XUE). Part of the QMC series (43"-85") sharing one connectivity spec: DP 1.2 x1, HDMI 2.0 x3 (HDMI 3 is ARC-capable per the user manual's rear-panel legend "HDMI 3 (ARC)"), USB 2.0 x2 (host ports, 1.0A/0.5A, for media playback not general host use, but modeled as bidirectional USB per USB-A convention), stereo mini-jack audio output, RS232C in/out for MDC daisy-chain control, RJ45 (10/100 Mbps, in) for LAN/MDC, and IR in for an external IR receiver cable. Internal power supply (AC 100-240V 50/60Hz) with an included detachable power cord; official docs do not show a rear-panel photo of the AC inlet for this larger QM-series chassis, so the connector is inferred to be a standard IEC inlet (consistent with Samsung's commercial QM/QB/QH display line and included "Power Cord" accessory) rather than confirmed via photo — flagged as the one inferred item. Grades: HDMI ports graded hdmi-2.0 and DP graded dp-1.2 per official Samsung spec sheet; RJ45 grade set to eth-100m reflecting the manual's explicit "(10/100 Mbps)" rating. USB ports left ungraded-version "usb-2.0" per official spec ("USB 2.0 (2)"). No SDI/BNC ports on this model.
